components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-emphasis action used for sign-in and primary tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); padding: 11px 22px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s, background 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #bef264; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action on dark or artwork surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); color: #ffffff; padding: 11px 22px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); transition: transform 0.18s, background 0.18s, box-shadow 0.18s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-library-card { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface-2); transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.18s ease; } .ds-library-card:hover, .ds-library-card:focus-within { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-library-art { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; overflow: hidden; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); } .ds-library-cover { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-library-card:hover .ds-library-cover, .ds-library-card:focus-within .ds-library-cover { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-library-content { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 14px; } .ds-library-topline { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-library-status { display: inline-flex; max-width: 100%; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--accent); color: var(--bg); padding: 4px 9px; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.04em; line-height: 1.4; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-library-favorite { display: inline-grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.24); border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.1); color: var(--accent); } .ds-library-favorite svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: currentColor; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-library-copy { min-width: 0; } .ds-library-title-link { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-library-title-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-library-title { display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden; margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.25; overflow-wrap: anywhere; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; } .ds-library-platforms { display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden; margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; } .ds-library-stats { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 14px; margin-top: auto; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding-top: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-library-stat { display: inline-flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 5px; } .ds-library-stat:first-child span { color: var(--accent); } .ds-library-art:focus-visible, .ds-library-title-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-library-card, .ds-library-cover { transition: none; } .ds-library-card:hover, .ds-library-card:focus-within, .ds-library-card:hover .ds-library-cover, .ds-library-card:focus-within .ds-library-cover { transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
This visual direction follows the supplied reference: a cinematic game shelf on a graphite field, punctuated by vivid lime for actions and active states. Real game artwork carries the color and personality; the interface keeps catalog facts and private player records easy to scan.

The catalog index is functional, not a decorative texture. Preserve explicit PS2 and PS3 entry points, use only real provider artwork and metadata, and keep private player records visually distinct from public catalog content.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite surfaces with vivid lime as the action and active-state color.
Compact, indexed catalog navigation and artwork-led game discovery.
Personal records presented as private, owner-controlled data.
dos: Retain PS2 and PS3 as first-class navigation destinations.
Distinguish unavailable provider data from an empty catalog result.
Keep personal notes and library activity private to their owner.
donts: Do not invent catalog data or imply console-account synchronization.
Do not make decorative patterns compete with the catalog index or game artwork.
